digest.component_or_area: review-bot shutdown lifespan and reconciler drain
propositions: The shutdown drain protects webhook-queued reviews via queue.join() but abandons reconciler reviews that call review_and_vote inline outside the queue, causing them to be cancelled within shutdown_cancel_seconds() when the queue empties immediately.

Any container stop outside the autodeploy path (manual docker compose restart, compose-up.sh, host reboot, systemd stop, autodeploy rollback) kills an in-flight reconciler review with no drain protection.
The reconciler is the self-heal retry path for reviews killed by other failures, so the drain gap blocks recovery and produces silent failures with no VOTER_ERROR emission.

The fix implements cooperative shutdown via request_stop() to prevent new reviews starting, then waits for in-flight reconciler reviews to complete within the existing shared shutdown_drain_seconds() budget before cancelling tasks.

The shutdown drain now gates on voter.in_flight_reviews() and records all held-back candidates to preserve the cursor low-water-mark invariant, preventing candidates from becoming unreachable after shutdown.
